Chapter 6247: Ye Sha

Chapter 6247: Ye Sha

The black fog had an aura effect and subjected everyone to Ye Sha's dominion.

"So this is the legendary Ye Sha." Li Xian murmured.

"It's real." Orchidcore and Princess Chen became alarmed.

Few had seen Ye Sha since it was sealed by the masters of Life and Death Heaven after its rampage.

Only the descendants of the clans still living in Old Ruin's outer region heard stories of it. Now, it was back after the rebuilding of Old Ruin.

"Was the explosion of that star the unsealing of Ye Sha?" Li Xian murmured, aware of more legends than the other youths.

"So strong, it can devour any emperor or desolate god." Mu Hu said. He had seen plenty of powerful characters including primal ancestors or greater beings.

Although this creature didn't exude any power or aura, its murderous potential was clear.

Meanwhile, everyone else was confused by the emergence of this nefarious creature.

"Go!" Everyone could hear the crown prince's shout as he released all his fate palaces and vitality.

The flame waves pulsed inward instead, forming a sun near his chest. He was a member of the fire tribe so with this form, he garnered an unbearable heat. His flames took the form of golden liquid metal.

"Clank!" Sword energies erupted and took physical forms.

"Righteous Solar Sword!" This was his supreme sword dao.

Despite not being at grand completion, chaos true energy and dao laws harmonized in preparation to greet a new grand dao.

"Boom!" The swords turned into suns and floated upward, releasing embers capable of world destruction. This fully displayed the might of the pseudo-emperor.

"A supreme genius indeed, he will become an emperor." Many cultivators shouted in admiration.

He lived up to his fame and proved his worth after the first move. He wanted to split the sky open on top of burning everything. Spectators thought he could cut the strange creature into two pieces.

"Whoosh!" Ye Sha suddenly flapped its wings and something terrifying occurred.

Space and time shattered immediately. Needless to say about the crown prince's attack, his sword dao and floating suns were extinguished like a flickering candle splashed with water.

Struck by the attack, he fell downward like a meteor and smashed through one peak after another.

"Damn!" An emperor immediately saved him, potentially his dao protector.

Everyone was caught off guard since while they were amazed by his power, he was swiftly defeated. Who knows if he was still alive?

"Raa!" Ye Sha seemed to be annoyed by the attack and roared at those beneath. It finally released its true power.

"Rumble!" Mountains disappeared in the blink of an eye.

"Ahhh!" Unlucky cultivators couldn't survive the sudden divinity and were reduced to blood.

"Oh, mother!" Li Xian and the others felt as weak as insects.

Black Witch Monarch reacted the fastest and hid behind Li Qiye. The latter flashed brightly and nullified the descending waves, protecting the youths.

Orchidcore and the others stared at Li Qiye in a stupor, finally realizing the truth.

"How dare you?!" A figure appeared in the sky and shouted at Ye Sha.
